page: Microsoft Azure L160iaos_v5 is an isolated, storage-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture. Running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 160 dedicated virtual central processing units and 1040.0 GB of system memory, which yields an allocation of 6.5 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not incorporate hardware graphics acceleration, operating with zero GPUs.

A defining hardware characteristic of the L160iaos_v5 configuration is its massive integrated storage subsystem. The virtual machine bundles 138,239 GB of high-speed local NVMe solid-state storage alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage. The architectural scale of this local disk array eliminates external network-attached storage bottlenecks for read- and write-intensive data pipelines.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server combines substantial multi-threaded compute density, high memory capacity, and immense bundled NVMe disk capacity onto a single isolated physical node. By packaging comprehensive storage capacity directly within the compute instance, it reduces reliance on large volumes of independently provisioned block storage volumes, improving density and infrastructure economics for data-heavy architectures.

This hardware footprint is suited for large-scale enterprise databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, massive data warehousing clusters, transactional processing systems, and big data extract, transform, load operations requiring extensive local cache and rapid disk access.
description: Microsoft Azure L160iaos_v5 is an isolated, storage-optimized instance built on x86_64 AMD processor architecture and managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provisions 160 dedicated vCPUs and 1040.0 GB of RAM, offering 6.5 GB of memory per core without GPU accelerators. Designed for high-throughput, data-intensive workloads, it incorporates 138,239 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. By integrating an exceptionally large local storage array with 160 dedicated execution threads and substantial system memory on a single dedicated node, the instance offers balanced density and efficiency for workloads that typically require extensive external disk arrays. The L160iaos_v5 is structured to support large-scale relational databases, NoSQL clusters, search indexing engines, distributed big data processing, and intensive extract, transform, load pipelines.
